response.core_entity: Multiple hereditary infundibulocystic basal cell carcinoma syndrome

modifier_claims.support_quote: Whole-exome sequencing revealed:    - A conserved splice-site mutation in SUFU gene (c.757-2A>G) in all tumor and normal tissue samples    - Additional distinct deletions of the trans SUFU allele in all tumor samples    - No deletions present in the normal sample
Eight lesions underwent biopsy, showing buds and cords of basaloid cells enclosing small cystic spaces. Clefting between tumor aggregates and the surrounding stroma was focally evident.
multiple dome-shaped, skin-colored asymptomatic papules located on the face and vulva
The lesions first appeared around 50 years of age and gradually increased to approximately 60 lesions
modifier_claims.value: onset around age 50 with gradual progression

modifier_claims.support_quote: Family history was notable for a daughter with similar facial papules that had not undergone biopsy
Medical history was significant for a meningioma
